preamble: Reduction of [ɛ] to the neutral vowel schwa [ə] is a common process in unstressed syllables, appearing in morphological alternations where stress shifts away from a syllable containing [ɛ].

examples.note: Stressed [ɛ] in the first syllable reduces to [ə] when stress moves to the second syllable.
'Earth' vs 'terrain'. Eastern Catalan reduces unstressed /a/, /e/, /ɛ/ to [ə].

sources: Carbonell, J. F. & Llisterri, J. (1992). Catalan. Journal of the International Phonetic Association 22(1–2), 53–56. https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/journal-of-the-international-phonetic-association/article/catalan/A1CC2DA4CD615FBC48964FA275F5386A
